# What does a slow first reply cost you?

> Free tool for home-service and other lead-driven businesses. Paste your leads with minutes to first reply and won or lost to see win rate by response time and the jobs and revenue a faster reply would have won. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
